name: [ARENA MODE] DeadMist 2 Beta
desc:
👍 Hit the THUMBS UP button for more future updates!

As the lab tests continued, an error, gone unnoticed, caused the world to spiral into an apocalypse. Now, as one of the few remaining survivors, you must scavenge, fight and survive in the breathtaking valleys of Mountain Springs, British Columbia.

This is no ordinary survival experience - Deadmist is about creating your own story within the game. You will fight against the harsh elements such the rain and cold. You will run into some friendly people who will help; some will not. Scavenge plenty of food, water, & weapons. You're going to need it in the world of Deadmist.

Premium members get DOUBLE the daily coins!

Development begun December 22nd, 2016. This is the successor of the classic game DeadMist.
